title: nerium indicum f. leucanthum
intro: Nerium indicum f. leucanthum, commonly known as the White Oleander or White Nerium, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, soothe wounds, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as pain, digestive issues, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Nerium indicum f. leucanthum include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
